newsitem.title: USA: Intelligent Electronics to sell unit to Ingram.
newsitem.headline: Intelligent Electronics to sell unit to Ingram.

text.p: Intelligent Electronics Inc said on Wednesday it signed a definitive agreement to sell its reseller network division to Ingram Micro Inc for about $78 million, subject to adjustment.
Intelligent Electronics estimated it will record a pre-tax gain of about $25 million before potential purchase price adjustments and transaction-related costs.
The purchase price will be payable in cash and assumption of liabilities, based on the business's balance sheet at closing.
Stock structures of both companies will remain unchanged.
The transaction, expected to close in approximately three months, is subject to required government approvals, approval by Intelligent Electronics' shareholders, and other customary conditions.
